headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and security checks to improve ClearInstall’s risk assessment capabilities, ensuring users are informed about potential risks before installation. Leverage machine learning models for predictive insights on package vulnerabilities.
actions: Implement real-time dependency scanning using public trend signals like Gathin23/cleanyourtv to detect potential security issues and outdated packages.
Integrate a machine learning model from projects such as deepseek-ai/DeepInfer to predict and flag risky dependencies based on historical data and current trend
